info.name: Dailyhunt Content Syndication Content Fetch API
Fetch content cards from a channel

params.name: partner
params.description: The partner identification code issued by Dailyhunt at onboarding.

params.name: cid
params.description: Channel id whose content cards should be returned.

params.name: langCode
params.description: Content language code — one of en, hi, mr, gu, pa, bn, kn, ta, te, ml, or, ur, bh, ne.

params.name: ts
params.description: Current client timestamp in milliseconds; must be included in the signed parameter set.

params.name: puid
params.description: The partner's unique id for the end user accessing the API (for example a device identifier). Dailyhunt maps it to an internal user id to personalize the feed.

params.name: pfm
params.description: Partner feature mask — the sum of the feature bits enabled for the partner or channel. LIVE_TV_CARD 1, CRICKET_CARD (brief) 8, HERO_CARD 16, VIDEO_CHANNELS 32, VIRAL_CHANNELS 64, CRICKET_CARD (detailed) 128. Bits 2 and 4 are reserved.

params.name: fm
params.description: Channel-level feature mask. Inherited from the channel `contentUrl`; only override when a specific change is needed for one channel.

params.name: fields
params.description: Field selection modifier as published in the reference (for example `none`).

params.name: pageNumber
params.description: Zero-based page number of the paginated response.

items.docs: Returns the paginated content cards (stories, videos, photos, DailyShare cards, banners, polls, HTML cards) for the channel identified by `cid`. Callers should prefer the `contentUrl` returned by the Channels API, which already carries the correct `fm` for the channel, and follow `nextPageUrl` for pagination. The response also carries the `trackUrl` and per-card `trackData` that must be POSTed back to the Tracking API.
